title: Shipping & delivery policy
lead: At Casely, every order is handled with care, from production to delivery. This policy outlines how we process, prepare and deliver orders to our customers.

sections.heading: 1. Order processing
bullets: Casely offers both ready-to-ship and made-to-order phone cases.
Ready-to-ship products are prepared for dispatch based on availability and order volume.
Made-to-order products require additional production time before they can be dispatched.
Production typically begins after payment and confirmation of an order.
Processing times may vary depending on product availability, order volume and production requirements.
Customers will be notified if there are any significant changes to the expected processing time.

sections.heading: 2. Delivery locations
paragraphs: We currently deliver within Ghana, with delivery arrangements depending on the customer's location.
Delivery availability and charges will be communicated during checkout or before order confirmation where necessary.

sections.heading: 3. Delivery timelines
bullets: Delivery timelines depend on the product ordered, production requirements and delivery location.
For made-to-order products, additional time is required for production before dispatch.
Once an order has been completed and dispatched, delivery timelines may vary depending on the destination and transportation arrangements.
Any estimated delivery timeframe communicated to a customer should be treated as an estimate rather than a guaranteed delivery date.

sections.heading: 4. Delivery fees
paragraphs: Delivery fees are determined by the customer's location and the applicable transportation arrangements.
Where delivery charges apply, they will be communicated before an order is completed.

sections.heading: 5. Order tracking and updates
paragraphs: Customers may receive updates through WhatsApp, phone calls or other available communication channels. Updates may include:
Customers are encouraged to provide accurate and accessible contact information to ensure smooth communication.

sections.heading: 6. Delivery delays
paragraphs: Although we make every effort to fulfil orders within the communicated timeframe, delays may occasionally occur due to production challenges, transportation issues, weather conditions or other unforeseen circumstances.
If a delay occurs, affected customers will be informed and provided with an updated delivery estimate.
If an order cannot be fulfilled or delivered within a reasonable period, customers may contact us to discuss cancellation and an appropriate refund in accordance with our Refund & Exchange Policy.

sections.heading: 7. Failed delivery attempts
paragraphs: Customers are responsible for providing accurate delivery addresses and being available to receive their orders.
If a delivery attempt is unsuccessful because the customer is unavailable or has provided incorrect delivery information, additional delivery arrangements or charges may apply.

sections.heading: 8. Incorrect or missing orders
paragraphs: If you receive an incorrect order or your order is not delivered, please contact us as soon as possible so we can investigate and resolve the issue.

sections.heading: 9. Contact information
paragraphs: For shipping and delivery enquiries, please contact us through our official customer service channels.
Thank you for choosing Casely. We appreciate your patience and support.
